title: FTC v. Amazon monopoly trial begins
summary: The FTC's monopolization case against Amazon, alleging illegal maintenance of an online-superstore and marketplace monopoly, is scheduled for trial starting February 9, 2027, per an amended federal court scheduling order, after an earlier October 2026 date was pushed back.

sources.title: Amazon loses bid to keep October 2026 trial date
Amazon Poised for Late 2026 Trial in FTC Monopoly Power Lawsuit

title: Let's Encrypt default profile switches to 64-day certificates
summary: Let's Encrypt will switch its default 'classic' ACME certificate profile to issuing 64-day certificates with a 10-day authorization reuse period.

sources.title: Shorter Certificate Lifetimes and Rate Limits

title: OpenAI retires whisper-1 and gpt-4o-transcribe family
summary: whisper-1, gpt-4o-transcribe, gpt-4o-mini-transcribe and gpt-4o-transcribe-diarize are scheduled for removal from the OpenAI API on February 26, 2027.
